[Case Study] Livensa Living For Livensa Living, keeping up with the rapidly surging demand for student housing hasn’t been easy. In the beginning, payment processing was done manually, took weeks, and offered no visibility. Livensa acknowledged that their current process wasn’t sustainable and went on the hunt for a solution to their payment challenges. ‌
In this case study, we explore why Livensa Living chose Flywire as their payment provider and how the switch has helped with saving time and cutting costs.
